      About this item

      • SPATIAL AUDIO: Unlock accurate 3D audio spatialization and localization! The included activation code provides 2 years of DTS Headphone:X Spatial Audio for enhanced perception, awareness, and immersion.
      • SIGNATURE HYPERX COMFORT: With memory foam ear cushions and soft leatherette, Cloud Stinger 2 delivers premium comfort without the luxury price tag
      • SUPERIOR SOUND: 50mm drivers produce sound with a wide frequency response that help you better pick up on audio cues and enhance your audio entertainment.
      • ADJUSTABLE ROTATING EARCUPS: When you’re ready to take a quick breather, the 90° rotating earcups swivel so you can rest them on your chest.
      • EASY- ACCESS AUDIO CONTROLS: With audio controls right on the headset itself, you won’t have to navigate a maze of menus to adjust the volume.
      • IMPROVED IN-GAME CHAT EXPERIENCE: HyperX quality of life features like the swivel-to-mute microphone are built to enhance your gaming experience. Simply flip the mic up and out of the way to know that you are on mute.

      From the manufacturer

      With a new design and 2 years of DTS Headphone:X Spatial Audio*, the Cloud Stinger 2 keeps the fundamentals of the Cloud Stinger and refines it. Still weighing in at under 300g, the Cloud Stinger 2 is lightweight, but also still packs a hefty audio punch. Get a wide frequency response so you won’t miss important audio cues that give your opponents away. It also doesn’t skimp on comfort, with soft memory foam and premium leatherette designed for all-day gaming. Gamers will appreciate HyperX’s passion for its craft, which shows up in quality-of-life features like rotating earcups that make it easy to take a break, or the swivel-to-mute microphone that makes muting your mic simple and obvious.

      Its swivel-to-mute mic and volume controls are located on the headset, grouping all your most important audio functions right on your head for easy access. The passively noise-cancelling microphone is flexible, so you can precisely position it to give you clear communication with your team.

      • Immersive DTS Headphone:X Spatial Audio
      • HyperX signature comfort
      • Superior sound
      • Adjustable rotating earcups
      • Easy-Access audio controls
      • Improved in-game chat experience
      • Compatibility: PC

      DTS Headphone:X Spatial Audio*

      Unlock accurate 3D audio spatialization and localization! The included activation code provides 2 years of DTS Headphone:X Spatial Audio for enhanced perception, awareness, and immersion.

      Signature HyperX Comfort

      With memory foam ear cushions and soft leatherette, Cloud Stinger 2 delivers premium comfort.

      Superior sound

      50mm drivers produce sound with a wide frequency response that helps you better pick up on audio cues and enhance your audio entertainment.

      Adjustable rotating earcups

      When you’re ready to take a quick breather, the 90° rotating earcups swivel so you can rest them on your chest.

      Easy-Access audio controls

      With audio controls right on the headset itself, you won’t have to navigate a maze of menus to adjust the volume.

      Improved in-game chat experience

      HyperX quality of life features like the swivel-to-mute microphone are built to enhance your gaming experience. Simply flip the mic up and out of the way to know that you are on mute.

      *DTS, DTS:X, DTS Sound Unbound, Headphone:X, the DTS logo, and the DTS:X logo are registered trademarks or trademarks of DTS, Inc. in the United States and other countries. 2020 DTS, Inc. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.

      Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings, help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

      To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

      4 out of 5 stars
      **Better for Beginners/Casuals; Dts Spatial Audio only Works on PC**
      I had purchased these from Curry's PC World when I went to pick up my curved gaming monitor (brand: Omen) and ordered a new gaming chair in store to be delivered to my address as it was not in stock at the storefront... I decided to buy these over a couple of other options and only intended to use them with my PS5. (At the time I was not fully aware that with this specific model, the Dts Spatial Audio does NOT save to the headset and carry-over to console/s - it was something that I had overlooked due to other headsets having this feature; I should not have presumed it would be the same...). Regardless of this fact, they are still highly compatible with a plethora of different devices via the 3.5mm audio jack that is commonplace on most devices. The 3D PS5 Audio settings should not be used simultaneously with any headset's spatial audio anyway, so it is not a 'main' feature per se... The audio quality/clarity is pretty good, it suffices as an immersion aid when playing games and suppresses outside noise but allows you to hear external sounds like phone ringtones, alerts and just about distinguish a door-knock without missing it (provided the volume is not at maximum and instead at 3/4 or less). That being said, I have had some issues with directional sounds, as footsteps and other elements are rather amplified to an extent that they are perceived as extremely close and in multiple directions when near but not next to the source of the noise which is somewhat disorienting when playing competitively on PS5, even with different console and in-game settings it is too vague for my liking... But, nonetheless, the clarity and depth of sounds and most directional noises are considerably clear & concise in all games (some more than others; like any Soulsborne or Soulslike game which is perfect all-round, but games like Rainbow Six Siege suffer from frequently vague, omni-directional sound cues that are very disorienting/hard to distinguish the exact location (distance & direction) of each sound, especially footsteps and other similar audio cues which inevitably leaves you guessing, as the sounds seem to be coming from multiple directions when it is usually just one (1 enemies' footsteps)). So I would suggest a different set if you are using these as a multi-platform headset or strictly for console (especially if you play competitively!) - but for casual gaming, they are almost perfect. The main and only real issue that I have encountered is a recent event; after about 7 months of daily use, I had experienced an exceptionally concerning issue, pertaining specifically to the 'right' earmuff/speaker, which at random and unexpected moments will either: completely lose all auido, play a horrible static sound, require 'pressure' to restore normal function/audio, sometimes cuts-out or goes really quiet with a static overtones if a loud sound plays through it and other similar variations of this issue, which heavily suggests that the internal wiring is partially compromised/loose and has prompted me to finally order a different, better headset with Dts Spatial Audio and EQ saveable settings that carry over to consoles... I can recommend this as: a beginner/casual headset, temporary replacement, use for a friend/guest during local co-op or a spare/emergency headset - it has remarkably good quality audio, flip-to-mute mic, easily operable volume control and is super comfortable + adjustable for those prolonged, extended sessions; it has a good weight to it, not too heavy, not too light, comfortable and does not cause any itchiness when in contact with the skin. Still a quality product, a shame that it is slowly degrading after 7 months (still better than a lot of other headsets). ***{EDIT}*** After purchasing a professional-grade PS5, Mobile App-Configurable (+ PC App) Headset, even when I tested the HUNDREDS of different EQ settings for specific games + the general EQ settings (+ PC-Configured Customised EQ)... it became oddly apparent that the sound quality from the HYPERX Cloud Stinger 2 Core Headset actually has a much clearer + crisper sound than the pro headset!? This was something that took me by surprise!.. Whereas the pro headset offers deeper bass + dynamic sounds & more 'thumpy' treble + compacted sounds, whilst elevating the richer tones into a generally darker atmosphere... the HYPERX produces a remarkably more consistent version of the sounds that are very clear and concise - with no shrouding or compromised elements to produce a deeper overall soundscape... just pure clean clarity and a good quality of every single soundbyte! Yes, it's less dynamic and can be considered as a "casual" tone, but you don't miss out on any elements or atmospheric background sounds (within the game environments), but the pro headset tries to make certain atmospheric noises more dynamic and Immersive, whilst amplifying certain frequencies for specific games' unique profiles and common-interest amplification (like footsteps for FPS games) - which inevitably renders the overall result largely inconsistent and requires a significant amount of time and patience to customise and perfect each of the many individual frequencies for each individual game!.. Although, after quite some time using the pro headset, you start to get used to the dynamic-richness of the sounds but you will NEVER be able to forget the clean sounds + amazing clarity of the cheaper HYPERX... It is literally ALWAYS in the back of your mind when playing with the pro headset! In conclusion, I really like the sound quality of the HYPERX, the only drawback is the build-quality... Mine started to degrade after a few months! Not ideal...

      • guinness908
        5.0 out of 5 stars Molto soddisfatto.
        Reviewed in Italy on 6 December 2025
        Pattern Name: earphonesStyle Name: WiredColour Name: black / redVerified Purchase
        Come utente delle cuffie gaming cablate HyperX Cloud Stinger II Core, sono rimasto colpito principalmente dal loro comfort eccezionale e dalla qualità audio sorprendentemente buona per la fascia di prezzo a cui appartengono. Le ho scelte come soluzione economica ma affidabile per le mie sessioni di gioco su PC e PS5, e devo dire che hanno superato le mie aspettative iniziali.

        La mia esperienza d'uso quotidiano

        La prima cosa che ho notato appena indossate è stata la loro leggerezza. Essendo realizzate principalmente in plastica, non pesano sulla testa anche dopo diverse ore di utilizzo. I padiglioni in memory foam rivestiti in tessuto creano un buon isolamento e sono molto confortevoli, anche se alcuni recensori hanno notato che potrebbero non essere l'ideale per chi porta gli occhiali per lunghi periodi.

        Per quanto riguarda l'audio, offrono un suono chiaro con bassi presenti e incisivi che aiutano molto nell'immersione in gioco. Nei titoli sparatutto (FPS), la spazialità è sufficiente per individuare la provenienza dei passi e degli effetti sonori. Non hanno la precisione chirurgica di cuffie di fascia alta, ma per il gaming occasionale o budget-oriented sono perfette.

        Il microfono è un punto di forza: la funzione "ribaltabile per il mute" è pratica e immediata. La qualità della registrazione è decente e i miei compagni di squadra mi sentono chiaramente su Discord.

        Vantaggi e Svantaggi (secondo me)

        I miei "Sì":

        Comfort e leggerezza: Posso indossarle per ore senza affaticamento.Qualità audio in gioco: I bassi potenti e l'audio posizionale sono validi per il gaming.Microfono pratico: Il sistema "flip-to-mute" è una genialata.Versatilità: Grazie al jack da 3,5 mm, funzionano su PC, PS4, PS5 e altri dispositivi.

        I miei "Mah":

        Materiali: La costruzione è interamente in plastica per mantenere la leggerezza, il che le fa sembrare un po' "economiche" al tatto.Volume: Avrei gradito un volume massimo leggermente più alto per apprezzare ancora di più la separazione del suono.Isolamento acustico: Sebbene i padiglioni isolino bene, in ambienti molto rumorosi si potrebbe faticare a sentire chiaramente.

        Verdetto Finale

        Le HyperX Cloud Stinger II Core sono, a mio avviso, un'ottima scelta economica per chi cerca un headset da gaming cablato che si concentri sulle prestazioni essenziali. Offrono un'esperienza audio immersiva e un comfort duraturo che le rende un "best value" nel segmento entry-level. Se hai un budget limitato e vuoi un prodotto affidabile e funzionale, non ti deluderanno. Se invece punti a materiali premium, audio surround avanzato o opzioni wireless, dovrai guardare altrove.

      About this Item

      • SPATIAL AUDIO: Unlock accurate 3D audio spatialization and localization! The included activation code provides 2 years of DTS Headphone:X Spatial Audio for enhanced perception, awareness, and immersion.
      • SIGNATURE HYPERX COMFORT: With memory foam ear cushions and soft leatherette, Cloud Stinger 2 delivers premium comfort without the luxury price tag
      • SUPERIOR SOUND: 50mm drivers produce sound with a wide frequency response that help you better pick up on audio cues and enhance your audio entertainment.
      • ADJUSTABLE ROTATING EARCUPS: When you’re ready to take a quick breather, the 90° rotating earcups swivel so you can rest them on your chest.
      • EASY- ACCESS AUDIO CONTROLS: With audio controls right on the headset itself, you won’t have to navigate a maze of menus to adjust the volume.
      • IMPROVED IN-GAME CHAT EXPERIENCE: HyperX quality of life features like the swivel-to-mute microphone are built to enhance your gaming experience. Simply flip the mic up and out of the way to know that you are on mute.

      Product description

      With a new design and 2 years of DTS Headphone:X Spatial Audio*, the Cloud Stinger 2 keeps the fundamentals of the Cloud Stinger and refines it. Still weighing in at under 300g, the Cloud Stinger 2 is lightweight, but also still packs a hefty audio punch. Get a wide frequency response so you won’t miss important audio cues that give your opponents away. It also doesn’t skimp on comfort, with soft memory foam and premium leatherette designed for all-day gaming. Gamers will appreciate HyperX’s passion for its craft, which shows up in quality-of-life features like rotating earcups that make it easy to take a break, or the swivel-to-mute microphone that makes muting your mic simple and obvious. Its swivel-to-mute mic and volume controls are located on the headset, grouping all your most important audio functions right on your head for easy access. The passively noise-cancelling microphone is flexible, so you can precisely position it to give you clear communication with your team.
